sources: Mohammad Mokhber (adviser/assistant to the supreme leader) and General Reza Talaeinik (Defence Ministry spokesperson), social posts via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Democratic Congress actually constrains Trump's Iran war (January budget lever) vs. a rebuke that only delays the next round

sections.what_happened: Mokhber: 'The criminal Trump made every possible effort to ensure his party's victory, but he received a resounding slap from his own people'; 'The true victor in this arena was Iran, which shifted the cost of war onto American soil'; continuing Trump's policy 'will squander the remnants of America's dignity... at the hands of the Iranian nation and the Axis of Resistance.' Talaeinik: 'with the failure of Trump and Netanyahu's warmongering policies becoming more apparent and the trend of their hegemony's collapse in the world, the steadfastness of the Iranian nation is more than ever inspiring to free nations.' Both follow the Qalibaf (1100-03) and Khamenei (1600-01) midterm readings; neither announces any new policy, strike, or negotiation move.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog only (1 countable family). The underlying posts ARE the primary source, so the single-family PASS condition applies and is flagged explicitly.
sections.what_disputed: Khamenei's own Nov 4 message (1600-01) undercuts the victory framing: he said US hostility will NOT change with party shifts, warning against 'even the slightest inclination towards submission'. Trump told the FT he has 'no immediate plans' to strike (0600-01) and told Fox the war was only 'part of' the losses (1500-04) — i.e. Washington has not conceded the war is lost. No Democratic leader has endorsed Tehran's reading.
sections.why_matters: Follow-on beat to the midterm-fallout chain (1100-01/1100-03/1500-04/1600-01): Tehran's victory lap widens from Khamenei/Qalibaf to the leader's adviser and the Defence Ministry. Usable as a closing beat inside a midterm-fallout Short; the quotes alone do not carry a standalone Short.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 13:30 + 13:50 GMT = 17:30 + 17:50 ): Two more senior Iranian officials claim the midterms as an Iranian victory — Mokhber: Trump got a 'resounding slap'; Defence Ministry spokesman Talaeinik: failure of Trump/Netanyahu 'warmongering' becoming clear
